description: This file contains implementation code for the Blake3 hash function optimized with SSE2 instructions, including functions for compressing data blocks, hashing multiple inputs, and SIMD vector manipulations.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i loadu(const uint8_t src[16])
methods.description: Loads 16 bytes into an __m128i register from unaligned memory.

methods.name: INLINE void storeu(__m128i src,uint8_t dest[16])
methods.description: Stores 16 bytes from an __m128i register into unaligned memory.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i addv(__m128i a,__m128i b)
methods.description: Performs vectorized addition of two __m128i registers.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i xorv(__m128i a,__m128i b)
methods.description: Performs vectorized XOR of two __m128i registers.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i set1(uint32_t x)
methods.description: Sets all four 32-bit lanes of an __m128i register to a given uint32_t value.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i set4(uint32_t a,uint32_t b,uint32_t c,uint32_t d)
methods.description: Sets four 32-bit lanes with specified values.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i rot16(__m128i x)
methods.description: Rotates 16-bit halves within 32-bit lanes.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i rot12(__m128i x)
methods.description: Rotates 32-bit integers right by 12 bits.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i rot8(__m128i x)
methods.description: Rotates 32-bit integers right by 8 bits.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i rot7(__m128i x)
methods.description: Rotates 32-bit integers right by 7 bits.

methods.name: INLINE void g1(__m128i * row0,__m128i * row1,__m128i * row2,__m128i * row3,__m128i m)
methods.description: Mixing function used in the compression rounds, updates four rows with a message block.

methods.name: INLINE void g2(__m128i * row0,__m128i * row1,__m128i * row2,__m128i * row3,__m128i m)
methods.description: Variant of the mixing function for different rounds.

methods.name: INLINE void diagonalize(__m128i * row0,__m128i * row2,__m128i * row3)
methods.description: Rearranges vector lanes for the round transformation.

methods.name: INLINE void undiagonalize(__m128i * row0,__m128i * row2,__m128i * row3)
methods.description: Reverts the lane arrangement post round transformation.

methods.name: INLINE __m128i blend_epi16(__m128i a,__m128i b,const int16_t imm8)
methods.description: Blends two vectors based on an immediate mask.

methods.name: INLINE void compress_pre(__m128i rows[4],const uint32_t cv[8],const uint8_t block[BLAKE3_BLOCK_LEN],uint8_t block_len,uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags)
methods.description: Prepares the state vectors and message schedule for compression rounds.

methods.name: void blake3_compress_in_place_sse2(uint32_t cv[8],const uint8_t block[BLAKE3_BLOCK_LEN],uint8_t block_len,uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags)
methods.description: Compresses a data block into the chaining value in-place using SSE2 instructions.

methods.name: void blake3_compress_xof_sse2(const uint32_t cv[8],const uint8_t block[BLAKE3_BLOCK_LEN],uint8_t block_len,uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t out[64])
methods.description: Performs compression and outputs extended output (XOF) using SSE2.

methods.name: INLINE void round_fn(__m128i v[16],__m128i m[16],size_t r)
methods.description: Executes a single round of the BLAKE3 permutation on vectors.

methods.name: INLINE void transpose_vecs(__m128i vecs[DEGREE])
methods.description: Transposes an array of __m128i vectors for lane shuffling.

methods.name: INLINE void transpose_msg_vecs(const uint8_t * const * inputs,size_t block_offset,__m128i out[16])
methods.description: Loads and transposes message vectors from input pointers for SIMD processing.

methods.name: INLINE void load_counters(uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,__m128i * out_lo,__m128i * out_hi)
methods.description: Calculates packed low and high parts of the counter, optionally incremented.

methods.name: void blake3_hash4_sse2(const uint8_t * const * inputs,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t * out)
methods.description: Hashes four input blocks in parallel using SSE2 instructions.

methods.name: INLINE void hash_one_sse2(const uint8_t * input,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t out[BLAKE3_OUT_LEN])
methods.description: Hashes a single input across one or more blocks using SSE2.

methods.name: void blake3_hash_many_sse2(const uint8_t * const * inputs,size_t num_inputs,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t * out)
methods.description: Processes multiple inputs in parallel, hashing many streams using SSE2.
